title: Refunds and Billing Adjustments Policy
content:
Refunds and Billing Adjustments Policy

Document ID: Policy_C20_refund_policy

Category: C20 — Refunds & Adjustments

Department: Billing

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Policy Statement

Defines eligibility and timelines for refunds arising from duplicate charges, billing errors, or service-credit commitments.

Purpose

Ensures consistent, compliant, and customer-fair treatment across all channels and customer segments.

Scope

Applies to all prepaid, postpaid, and (where noted) enterprise customers, and to all NovaTel-authorised channels.

Definitions

**Customer** — any individual or entity holding an active NovaTel connection or account.

**Working day** — a business day excluding weekends and public holidays.

Eligibility

Applies to customers with an active, KYC-verified account in good standing, subject to the rules and exceptions below.

Rules

Confirmed duplicate or erroneous charges are refunded in full.

Refunds to source payment methods are processed within 5-7 working days of approval; account-balance credits are processed within 24 hours.

SLA-breach service credits (e.g., broadband downtime) are applied automatically without requiring a customer request.

Exceptions

Enterprise/pooled accounts may follow their signed commercial agreement instead.

Approval Requirements

Exceptions to standard rules require documented supervisor or department-head approval before being applied.

Responsibilities

Compliance Requirements

This policy is designed to align with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g. TRAI/DoT guidance) as general background context; it is not a substitute for legal advice.

Audit Considerations

All exceptions and manual overrides must be logged with justification for periodic audit review.

Escalation

Where first-line steps do not resolve the issue within the stated timeframe, the case is escalated to the next tier with full interaction history attached, and the customer is informed of the new reference and expected timeline.

Effective Date / Version

Version 1.0, effective 2026-08-08.

Review Cycle

This policy is reviewed annually or upon material regulatory change, whichever is earlier.

No directly linked documents are recorded for this item; refer to the relevant department for further guidance.
